summary_md: **Nicolò Boschi ([@nicoloboschi](https://x.com/nicoloboschi/status/2115730688330629600))** argues engineers should build their own dev stack and shares his: **sheepit**, an IDE/browser terminal where agents work and you review; **giotto**, where agents draw diagrams; and **ciak**, where agents record the screen and take screenshots ([sheepit](https://github.com/nicoloboschi/sheepit), [giotto](https://github.com/nicoloboschi/giotto), [ciak](https://github.com/nicoloboschi/ciak)).
